description: This file defines data structures and functions for handling configuration schema nodes, UI hints, and paths within a configuration system. It includes enums, structs, and utility functions for parsing, navigating, and analyzing configuration schemas.

methods.name: init(raw: [String: Any])
methods.description: Initializes a ConfigUiHint instance from a dictionary, parsing various optional fields.

methods.name: init?(raw: Any)
methods.description: Initializes a ConfigSchemaNode from a raw Any object if it's a dictionary.

methods.name: node(at path: ConfigPath) -> ConfigSchemaNode?
methods.description: Navigates the schema node hierarchy based on the provided path.
